**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

**About the Role:**  
The primary responsibility of the Loyalty Client Support Engineer is to assist with the management and support of the technical solution for an existing large financial services client. They will act as the backbone of daily production processes and procedures; monitoring and escalating if alignment is not achieved with standard operating procedures.
  
  
The individual in this position will be support coverage for "Lights On" support, SLA Adherence, and operational monitoring while displaying a deep understanding solution standards, features, and dependent functionalities associated to the account.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Ensure batch files are received and sent according to File Processing Schedule, that no large-scale errors have occurred, and escalate where needed.
* Monitor API processing to determine reasons for any errors, initiate reprocessing where necessary, and obtaining the appropriate approvals to proceed.
* Ensuring reports are sent according to the report distribution schedule.
* Gather data for monthly SLA Reporting and present to the internal team and client.
* Optimize monitoring tools and alerting to ensure first to identify and increase efficiency around time to resolution.
* Create and maintain monitoring patching schedules, ensuring testing approval is received prior to production release.
* Gathering inputs around production readiness activities to ensure completion prior to technical releases.
* Leading Change Approval Board meetings internally to achieve alignment on production readiness.
* Reviewing vulnerabilities found through scanning to determine activities necessary for remediation.
* Manage documentation and requests surrounding certificates necessary to maintain day-to-day access security.
* Change scheduling and submission of necessary data required for change approval.
* Create and maintain training materials, standard operating procedures, and core system documentation.
* Configure and implement systems and programs to automate tasks and processes.
* Maintain and continuously improve production monitoring capabilities, operational dashboards, and KPI reporting to ensure platform availability, SLA adherence, proactive issue identification, and rapid incident resolution.
* Collaborate with STS, Infrastructure, Windows, and Network engineering teams to improve system reliability, optimize monitoring coverage, address operational gaps, and maintain service availability in accordance with SLA commitments.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum of 5 years of production support experience in SLA-driven environments.
* Demonstrated ability to own incidents from triage through communication, escalation, root cause analysis, and runbook or knowledge base updates.
* Comfortable participating in on-call rotations and providing after-hours production support when required.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Soft Skills Required:**
  

* Possesses strong technical, analytical, and troubleshooting skills to analyze requests, identify anomalies across Windows server environments and related infrastructure components, determine root cause, and drive production and project issues through to successful resolution.
* Possesses strong technical, analytical, and SQL-based troubleshooting skills to analyze requests, identify anomalies, determine root cause, and drive production or project issues to effective closure.
* Able to quickly develop rapport, establish credibility, and maintain trusted relationships with business, technical, global, and external partner teams.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence a wide range of stakeholders across all roles and levels.
* Contribute to effective client meetings, make proactive recommendations, and drive successful outcomes in your area of expertise.
* Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and often changing environment.
* Shows drive, initiative, and a sense of personal accountability.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, interpersonal, and time management skills.

  
**Technical Skills Required:**
  

* 5+ years supporting Windows Server in production environments, with experience across the 2016-2022 era and strong Windows Server 2022 experience preferred.
* 3+ years troubleshooting IIS-hosted applications in live production environments.
* Hands-on Windows Services, IIS administration, including sites, applications, application pools, web.config/applicationHost.config, handlers, and modules.
* Ability to diagnose common HTTP failures, including 401, 403, 500, 502, and 503 errors, and restore service under SLA.
* Experience using Failed Request Tracing (FREB), IIS/W3C logs, Windows Event Logs, and PerfMon for production diagnostics.
* Experience troubleshooting application pool issues, including recycles, rapid-fail protection, identity and permissions, and startup failures.
* Working knowledge of TLS/HTTPS bindings, certificates, SNI, and common Schannel/TLS breakages.
* Hands-on experience managing Windows Server vulnerabilities, including vulnerability assessment, patch planning, remediation validation, exception management, and coordination with infrastructure and security teams.
* Experience supporting ASP.NET Framework and/or ASP.NET Core applications on IIS, including ANCM and hosting model issues.
* PowerShell experience for remote administration, automation, and diagnostics.
* Active Directory fundamentals as they affect applications, including Kerberos/NTLM, SPNs, service accounts, and double-hop scenarios.
* Networking fundamentals for production applications, including DNS, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies.
* Solid understanding of Relational Database Management Systems and proficiency with SQL.
* Proficient with Business Intelligence tools such as Cognos.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies and creation of defined artifacts.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise production monitoring, operational health management, KPI development, SLA measurement, trend analysis, and service reporting to ensure application availability, performance, and operational excellence.
* Proven experience collaborating with STS, Infrastructure, Windows Server, Network, and Security teams to troubleshoot production issues, improve system reliability, optimize monitoring coverage, and support critical service availability objectives.
* Experience creating operational dashboards, service health views, and KPI reporting that support global follow-the-sun operations, enabling proactive monitoring, effective incident triage, and seamless cross-regional support handoffs.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum development is a plus.
* Understanding of consumer financial regulations is preferred.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**
  

* Ability to capture memory dumps and use tools such as DebugDiag, ProcDump, WinDbg, or SOS to debug and diagnose application hangs, crashes, and memory-related issues.
* Experience troubleshooting ARR, URL Rewrite, and reverse-proxy configurations.
* Performance tuning experience, including queues, memory leaks, GC/thread-pool pressure, and capacity signals.
* Experience with multi-node IIS farms, NLB, or failover clustering.
* Familiarity with ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Experience with centralized logging and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, ELK, SCOM, or Azure Monitor agents.
* Experience configuring, administering, and leveraging enterprise monitoring and observability platforms such as OpsRamp, ThousandEyes, Sumologic and Kibana, including creating dashboards, alerts, and service health views to support proactive monitoring, incident response, and follow-the-sun global support operations.

* Experience with the WAF ThreatX.

**Job Description**


Hybrid Cloud, Wintel \& Backup Engineer (L2\)


Hybrid Cloud, Wintel \& Backup Engineer responsible for providing L2 operational support across Microsoft Azure, Windows Infrastructure, Active Directory, VMware virtualization, Veeam Backup \& Replication, and Cohesity DataProtect environments. The role focuses on infrastructure administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, backup and recovery operations, patch management, identity management, and service reliability across hybrid cloud and on\-premises environments. The position combines strong operational expertise, customer support, infrastructure governance, and continuous improvement within a cloud\-first enterprise environment.

* Execute backup, restore, recovery validation, and disaster recovery readiness activities for enterprise workloads.
* Support VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter environments.
* Support SSL/TLS certificate installation, renewal, lifecycle tracking, and compliance activities.
* Participate in incident resolution, major incident bridges, root cause analysis, and change implementation activities.
* Identify opportunities for automation through PowerShell scripting and operational improvements.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
